name: Same-game side+total parlay
rule: Frozen before the first bet. Any change to signal, threshold, universe or settlement is a NEW strategy with a NEW id and a new hash; the old record is never edited, so a reader can always tell whether the rule moved.
settlement_rule: both legs win. Priced with the MEASURED margin/total rho from the backtest, and the naive product printed next to it.
signal: same game: side under A and an over/under read from the possession total
thesis: The brief asks for the measured rho beside the naive product rather than withholding the price. v3 measures r on 152 finals and publishes the interval.
